responsibility: VxWorks-specific crtbegin startup-object variant for GNAT exception-handling support when the kernel module loader is configured to run C++ constructors and destructors automatically. It instantiates the shared vx_crtbegin.inc logic that defines the .eh_frame registration and deregistration routines, but makes those ctor/dtor functions local and additionally publishes _ctors and _dtors arrays containing the registration hooks so the VxWorks loader can discover and invoke them without relying on externally visible symbols. This file therefore owns the automatic-loader invocation strategy for EH-frame setup on VxWorks, as distinct from the plain vx_crtbegin.c wrapper that only provides callable registration entry points.
